task-inquiry

<用户自制> 任务探究：用证据与针对性提问澄清有实质影响的分歧。 Use when competing interpretations, an observed mismatch, or an unsettled user-owned choice could change the task's next action.

GitHub source

When to use it

Use it when results differ from expectations, explanations conflict, or a meaningful choice changes the next action. Clear, settled work can proceed directly.

“This report differs from the dashboard; find evidence that can explain the discrepancy.”

What is included

Includes the standalone method and bilingual guides, with no scripts, required companion framework, or service integration.

Ask naturally; if the client supports explicit invocation, select task-inquiry。The client’s existing authority, authentication, and tool boundaries remain in force.
